en-US.description: Lightweight Windows tray app that monitors your Claude rate limits in real time - portable single EXE, zero configuration, fully auditable
en-US.longDescription: Lightweight Windows tray app that monitors your Claude rate limits in real time - portable single EXE, zero configuration, fully auditable
en-US.name: Usage-Monitor-for-Claude
en-US.releaseNotes:
Added
- Refresh now - a button next to the update time in the detail popup and an entry in the tray menu fetch new numbers on demand instead of waiting for the next poll. While a refresh has to wait - right after the last update, or shortly before a quota resets - the button's tooltip shows how long (thanks to @regisbsb for the contribution)
Fixed
- The detail popup shows your plan under the name claude.ai uses - e.g. "Ultra" instead of "Claude Max" since the Max 20x plan was renamed - and hovering the plan shows the plan identifiers Anthropic reports for your account
